must_satisfy.statement: The production assessment tool must persist the evidence-backed revision verdict.

must_not.statement: The runtime result must not be backfilled from this oracle.

acceptable_variations: The public feedback wording may vary while the persisted score remains below threshold.
critical_failures: Producing a verdict without invoking the production submission check tool.
adjudication_note: Engineering-chain oracle only; it is never model-visible.
